options: How much mass is packed into a given space
How heavy an object is regardless of size
How much volume an object takes up
questions.why: The video defines density as mass packed into volume.

questions.q: A metal cube has a mass of 8 g and a volume of 2 cm³. What is its density?
questions.why: 8 g divided by 2 cm³ equals 4 g/cm³.

questions.q: A block has a mass of 30 g and a volume of 10 cm³. What is its density?
questions.why: Using d = m / V, 30 g divided by 10 cm³ equals 3 g/cm³.
